summary: Phase 8 full backend + UI validation. New file /app/backend/tests/test_members_phase8.py (22 tests, 100% PASS) covers: (1) GET/PUT /api/admin/members/photo-settings — admin-gated, 400 on invalid staff_alert or approve_notice, persistence of settings; (2) POST /api/members/albums/{mid}/photos/done — alerted True once for member-uploaded pending (sets staff_alerted=True on all pending rows), False on repeat, False when uploader is admin, and False when setting is daily/off (and staff_alerted remains unset in those cases); (3) _send_photo_pending_summary() direct — returns False with 0 pending, returns True when settings.staff_notify_email is set and sends exactly 1 summary email with meeting title + count; (4) approve flow with approve_notice='gathering' — approve sets notified=False, _send_photo_approved() groups uploader+meeting into one email saying '2 of your photos are now in...', second call returns 0 (idempotent via notified flag); approve_notice='each' triggers background notify (notified flips to True post-approve); (5) GET /api/members/albums/{mid}/download returns application/zip w/ attachment Content-Disposition, zip contains only approved rows (pending excluded), 404 when no approved photos, auth required (401 without cookie); GET /api/members/gathering-photos/{pid}/file?download=1 returns attachment Content-Disposition, inline (no param) does not; (6) PUT /api/members/profile persists bday_notices + bday_card both ways; _send_birthday_emails(today) skips celebrant's card when bday_card=False and skips opted-out recipients (bday_notices=False); (7) GET /api/members/birthdays/{uid}/wall — requires member auth (401/403), 404 for unknown uid, returns user_id/year/month/day + wishes[] drawn from year's birthday:<uid>:<year> thread replies after POST /members/birthdays/{uid}/wish. Phase 7 regression /app/backend/tests/test_members_phase7.py 35/35 PASS. Frontend (Playwright, viewport 1920x4000): Admin > Members > members-sub-photos renders photo-settings-staff + photo-settings-approve selects; changing staff_alert to 'daily' persists through full page reload (verified value='daily'). Member A /members portal: profile-bday-notices + profile-bday-card checkboxes present on My Profile tab, unchecking + Save + full reload keeps both unchecked (persistence confirmed), then restored. On the Announcements tab with A's birthday set to today's ET month/day: my-wishes-card renders with my-wishes-count='1' (matches 1 posted wish), birthdays-card renders with wall-link-qa_mem_a 'View wishes'. /birthday-wishes/qa_mem_a page: birthday-wall-page container, wall-title='Happy Birthday, Ama!', wall-wishes grid with wall-wish-<id> (1 item), wall-print-btn and wall-back links all render. Album flow (Photos tab): album-tile for seeded in-person QA meeting opens album view with album-download-zip link; clicking first thumbnail opens lightbox exposing album-photo-download link for approved photos. No console errors captured during any flow. All QA data (members, admin session, QA meetings, gathering photos, birthday threads) cleaned via qa_members.py down + qa_session.py down + explicit mongo deletes; photo-settings restored to {staff_alert:'both', approve_notice:'gathering'}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~9128 lines. Phase 8 added ~160 lines inline (photo-settings endpoints, done endpoint, _send_photo_pending_summary, _send_photo_approved, album download, birthday wall). The entire member-portal block (Phases 2-8) should be split into backend/members/*.py routers; same recommendation as iteration_27 and iteration_28.

_send_photo_approved marks notified=True BEFORE awaiting send_email per (uploader,meeting) group. If send_email raises, those photos are silently lost from future sends. Consider updating 'notified' only after a successful send (same pattern as _send_prayer_author_digests feedback from iteration_28).

/api/members/albums/{mid}/download loads all approved photos (up to 300) + fully reads each blob from storage into memory via get_object() and writes to an in-memory BytesIO. For a popular album (100+ photos) this will spike memory and block the event loop for the duration — consider StreamingResponse with an async generator or a background job that emails a signed one-time download URL.

ZIP entries are named by numeric index + extension only (f'{i:03d}.ext'); the uploader's name/caption is lost. Minor UX issue — users unzipping the archive cannot tell which sister contributed which photo. Consider '{idx}_{uploader-first-name}_{caption-slug}.ext'.
members_album_upload_done re-reads _photo_settings() + runs an update_many on every upload-done ping, even when the member had no new uploads. Low cost but worth noting.

GET /api/members/birthdays/{uid}/wall allows any active member to view any sister's wishes thread for any year via ?year=... (no bound). Not a security issue (wishes are shareable) but there is no rate-limit; a scraper could enumerate ~N users ~Y years cheaply. Phase-7 _rate_limit utility is already used elsewhere.

MyWishes component computes 'this month' via `new Date().getMonth()+1` in browser time, while server uses _today_et() (ET). On the last/first day of a month, a sister in a non-ET timezone could see or miss the card by one calendar day. Low priority but could be aligned to ET like other member-portal date logic.

PhotoSettingsIn Pydantic model has no field length limits — strings are only range-validated. Fine because of the explicit `in (...)` guard, but adding `Literal[...]` types would let FastAPI validate at parse time and auto-generate the OpenAPI enum.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase 8 testids present and functional (admin photo-settings, My Profile bday checkboxes, my-wishes-card, birthdays-card wall-link, BirthdayWall page, album-download-zip, album-photo-download)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 8 regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_members_phase8.py (22 tests). Prereq same as phase 7: qa_session.py up && qa_members.py up && mongo update member_status='active' for qa_mem_a/b. Run: python3 -m pytest backend/tests/test_members_phase8.py -o 'addopts=' -p no:warnings --junitxml=test_reports/pytest/iterNN.xml. The module uses the same shared asyncio loop + _rebind_motor pattern as phase 7 for direct function calls into server.py (_send_photo_pending_summary, _send_photo_approved, _send_birthday_emails, _photo_settings). Phase 7 and Phase 8 can run back-to-back without rate-limit collisions (Phase 8 tests use HTTP endpoints that are not shared-bucket rate-limited). Admin photo-settings UI is reached via /admin -> click 'Members' tab -> click 'members-sub-photos' sub-tab (NOT /admin/members, which 404s or stays on dashboard). Member Announcements tab must be the active tab for my-wishes-card + birthdays-card to render; sessionStorage key 'csc_member_tab' persists the last tab across reloads.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found in Phase 8 backend or frontend. The two initial UI-script dead-ends during testing (members-sub-photos not found at /admin/members; my-wishes-card absent on first portal load) were test-script navigation issues — admin page lives at /admin with internal tabs, and the member portal remembers the last-active tab in sessionStorage. Both verified green after correcting the navigation.
